source.rationale: THE ONE BEHAVIOURAL DIFFERENCE between this node and dym-transform: the partial twin's DOMAIN_PROBE has no `promotion` entry, because the partial lane comes off the RESULTS arm of If6 where a promotion miss cannot arrive. Copying the promotion entry across — the obvious 'they are twins, sync them' edit — is exactly what this pins.
